notice: PROTOTYPE: this is not an official RMB application. Contacts, emergency numbers, routing and response times are placeholders until RMB confirms them. Case references are generated by this demonstration system.
welcome: Hello, I am the RMB information assistant (prototype). I can answer questions from RMB documents, with sources, and log requests, complaints and reports for RMB staff. Ask me about licensing, minerals, petroleum and gas, or mining safety. This demo works in English only.
disclaimer: General information from RMB documents, not legal advice. The official documents and RMB officers are authoritative.
not_found: The verified documents currently loaded in this prototype do not support an answer to that question, so I will not guess. I can help you prepare an enquiry for the demonstration case workflow.

emergency_message: This may be a mining emergency. Use the on-site emergency procedure and contact locally verified emergency services immediately. This prototype cannot contact anyone. The contacts below are placeholders, not verified emergency numbers, and must not be relied on.
